facts: agent/turn_usage.py:192-193 writes cache= only when cache_read_tokens is non-zero; :96 is the usage=unavailable line
agent/usage_pricing.py:625-627 reads each usage field with _first_nonzero, so a field the provider omits becomes 0
agent/bedrock_adapter.py:863-869 and agent/gemini_native_adapter.py:587-591 write absent cache counters as an explicit 0 (the same sites #121135's automated review lists under Blocker 2)
so on a legacy line a route with no cache counter has no cache= and the patched parser counts it as zero-hit

the dd4dd10611 docstring states the rule (no cache= is a zero-hit call; cache_state=no_field stays out of the ratio) but does not say that legacy lines cannot separate a miss from a route with no cache counter
